source.source_boundary: Installed dictionary lists OPHOURS or a defined OperationParameter for traditional Item/ItemFailureRate OPID. CALHOURS and MISSIONS are predefined parameters; the FailureMode CALHOURS branch is separately accepted in D02.var02. Native input conversion decides whether the proposed traditional values are accepted.

delta.mechanism: Two Item.OPID negative candidates and two ItemFailureRate.OPID negative candidates, plus a rate-ophours structural positive control. Other accepted D01 configuration is fixed.

rate-ophours.hypothesis: native conversion and simulation accept structural positive control

predeclared_native_acceptance: Each variant runs through the guarded session-0 SSH CLI runner with the host-wide mutex and GUI PID 13340 identity guard; source and raw bytes are sealed even for expected nonzero outcomes.
The OPHOURS ItemFailureRate control must import, export, convert and simulate with zero conversion errors, distinguishing a valid table from unsupported clock values.

For each negative candidate, a source-bound native conversion error must identify the disallowed OPID or relevant table field. An import failure alone is acceptable only if the native diagnostic directly identifies the invalid OPID.
Record exact native exit codes, diagnostics, raw output size and any truncation; do not label an error as unsupported without a relevant diagnostic.
Independent reviewer replays all five variants and distinguishes published negative capability from inconclusive probes.
limits: Negative conversion evidence is version-specific to installed SIMLOX executable SHA fe24c5bffc0c0641894bb335484cfb83993e3db2bd60122ddadfedd39a8c4db0.
The OPHOURS rate control may override the base Item.FRT; its stochastic outcome is not used as a general reliability claim.
No alternative custom OperationParameter identifiers, GUI visual content or cross-engine equivalence are tested.
